The institutional investor held 36,853 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.34 million, up from 11,772 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cognios Capital Llc who had been investing in Altria Group Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $123.72B market cap company. The stock increased 1.56% or $1 during the last trading session, reaching $65.07. About 2.71 million shares traded. Altria Group, Inc. (NYSE:MO) has risen 11.92% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 4.78% the S&P500.
